sentences.text: Agentic AI is in production at TD Bank, which has introduced agents to automate mortgage funding and discharge, and at Wells Fargo, which deploys agents to find cyber vulnerabilities.
In pilots, Huntington Bank opened early access to an agent platform for small businesses, and Mashreq is testing IBM Bob for software engineering.
In lending, Colony Bank cut its business loan process to 32 steps with Lama AI, and Customers Bank announced AI-led automation of commercial client onboarding.

In financial crime, Security Bank widened sanctions screening with AI, Ping An Digital Bank completed an HKMA sandbox trial of deepfake detection, and Starling aims to use a fraud model from early 2027.
